ecovacs robotics - deebot x9 pro omni ro.name: ECOVACS Robotics - DEEBOT X9 PRO OMNI Robot Vacuum & Mop, 16,600Pa, OZMO Roller Mop Self-Washing, ZeroTangle 3.0, Hot-Wash OMNI Station - Black
ecovacs robotics - deebot x9 pro omni ro.description: The ECOVACS DEEBOT X9 PRO OMNI combines BLAST high-airflow vacuuming with OZMO Roller self-cleaning mopping for powerful, adaptive whole-home floor care. The BLAST cleaning system pairs 16,600Pa suction with high airflow to capture dust, crumbs, pet hair and larger debris across carpets and hard floors. For mopping, the OZMO Roller continuously refreshes itself with clean water while removing dirty water and debris during cleaning, helping tackle stubborn stains while keeping the roller refreshed from one area to the next. TruEdge 2.0 extends the roller closer to walls, corners and furniture edges for improved edge coverage, while the intelligent Triple Lift system adapts different cleaning components to carpets, liquid spills and larger debris for more precise wet and dry cleaning. AIVI 3D 3.0 uses AI-powered vision and 3D sensing to recognize everyday household obstacles and navigate changing environments with fewer interruptions. YIKO-GPT and the ECOVACS HOME App make it easy to start, schedule and customize cleaning using voice, text or app controls. After cleaning, the all-in-one OMNI Station automatically empties the dustbin, washes the roller with hot water, dries it with hot air, refills the robot, dispenses cleaning solution and cleans the station tray for a more hands-free cleaning experience.
